raw_sections.summary:
PERSONAL SUMMARY
Data Governance Professional with 6.7 years of overall IT experience, including 3.6 years in Data Governance and 3 years in Application Support. Experienced in the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform, specializing in Metadata Ingestion, Data Cataloging, Data Lineage, and Data Quality. Skilled in working with PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Snowflake, with a strong understanding of metadata management, data governance, and data stewardship.
raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Data Governance: Collibra Data Catalog, Metadata Ingestion (EDGE), Data Lineage,
Data Profiling, Data Classification (PII), Data Stewardship, Business Glossary.
Databases: Snowflake, Oracle, Postgres, SQL. • Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, ECS), Jenkins, Unix, DevOps Basics.
TOOLS • Collibra, ServiceNow, Jenkins, Mobaxterm, Toad, DBeaver, WinSCP, Postman, FileZilla
TECHNOLOGY SKILLS
AWS • SQL • Unix Commands • Jenkins
DevOps basics • Python basics
raw_sections.experience:
WORK HISTORY
Collibra Data Governance Analyst | Cognizant (Project: S&P Global) Jan 2023 – Present
Metadata Architecture: Orchestrated seamless metadata ingestion from Postgres,
Oracle, and Snowflake using Collibra EDGE.
Automation & Efficiency: Automated schema refresh and profiling schedules in
Collibra to maintain continuous data governance.
Security & Compliance: Configured automated Data Classification and profiling jobs
to identify PII and sensitive data.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborated with Business Stakeholders, Data
Owners and Data Stewards to define data requirements, business rules, ownership
and governance standards across critical data domains.
Business–Technical Bridge: Acted as a bridge between business and technical teams, working closely with Data Engineering and IT teams to translate business data requirements into practical governance and data-management solutions.
Data Security & Governance: Partnered with IT and Security teams to ensure
data was properly governed, secure and compliant with established access, quality and governance standards.
Data Asset Management: Designed and maintained the Collibra Data Catalog to
enable business users to discover and trust enterprise data assets.
Standardization: Developed Business Glossary and Data Dictionary assets to
standardize business terms and improve collaboration.
Conducted data profiling using SQL on Bonds and Ratings datasets to identify data
quality issues and support improvements across accuracy, completeness,
consistency, and validity dimensions.
Application Support Analyst | Cognizant (Project: S&P Global) Nov 2019 – Dec 2022

Infrastructure Management: Managed application infrastructure utilizing the AWS
console for EC2 instances and ECS clusters.
Release Management: Led critical production releases for global applications using
Jenkins and Unix.
Operational Excellence: Conducted daily checkouts for global stock market indices
to ensure accurate market processes.
Monitoring: Monitored application servers for CPU, memory, and disk utilization to
ensure optimal performance.
